scope: Promote already-playing direct managed media at0 to software rotation without Clear/Apply, rewind, identity/generation/counter reset. Real hardware deferred.

contract.handoff: Serialized LCD actor joins direct reader and receives pinned source plus next delivered frame index, independent of prefetch. Backup source shares legacy Arc bytes or clones indexed fd/index. Positional I/O prevents shared file-offset races.
contract.decoder: Start at preceding IDR; when seeking into a later GOP, first prime decoder using AU0 containing SPS/PPS. Discard priming/reference pictures before composition render/encode/output credits. Encoder first exposed AU is the requested next frame as IDR. Later keyframes need not repeat SPS/PPS.
contract.state: Retain source/media identity, pins, generation, counters, started time and deadline. Existing angle-only changes emit no LCDControl; combined brightness waits for config ACK. No persistent synthetic theme, rotated asset copy, or raw diagnostic clip extension. Returning to0 retains composition until replacement; restart at0 uses direct reader.
contract.failure: Prepare first AU before mutation. Decoder/config failure joins new worker and resumes direct reader at same index, leaving requested/applied angle/settings unchanged. Shutdown cancels first-AU wait; shutdown observed after config ACK never starts a new AU.
contract.limits: Preparation temporarily pauses LCD output; next-AU wait has10-second timeout. Filesystem operations retain ownership through joins. Device buffer latency, visible pause/FPS and native error/cancel qualification remain unverified.

codec.coverage: Actual FFmpeg8-frame H264 source, GOP4, removed SPS/PPS from all later AUs, indexed file. Consume5 direct units; promote at frame5 from IDR4; concurrent backup reader verifies original bytes while decoding. Eight decoded output frame colors continue5/6/7/0/1/2/3/4, no rewind or skip.

faults.coverage: Actual builtin source plus real oversize decoder failure; injected config failure and shutdown after config ACK. Original next AU, requested/applied angle, generation/counters/settings preserved; no new-angle frame emitted.

ipc.coverage: Private DeviceManager/IPC/FirmwareMock; saved direct media0 -> live0/90/180/270 promotion -> JPEG hardware270 -> media270 restart -> streaming theme270 restart. Same generation/source/media ID, nondecreasing sent_frames, no synthetic theme/no extra LCDControl on angle-only updates; wire rotation0 verified.

plans.deleted: none; all active plans still contain open requirements
